================================================================================

BEGIN
  tax := subtotal * 0.06;
  my_record.user_id = 20;
  my_array[j] := 20;
  my_array[1:3] := array[1, 2, 3];
  complex_array[n].realpart = 12.3;
  $1 := -1;
END

================================================================================
SQL statements
================================================================================

BEGIN
  CREATE TABLE mytable (id int primary key, data text);
  INSERT INTO mytable VALUES (1, 'one'), (2, 'two');
  UPDATE mytable SET data = 'x' WHERE id = 1 RETURNING id INTO STRICT myid;
  DELETE FROM mytable WHERE id = 2;
  SELECT * INTO myrec FROM emp WHERE empname = myname;
  WITH t AS (SELECT 1) SELECT * FROM t;
  CALL triple(myvar);
  SET search_path = public;
END

================================================================================
Dynamic commands
================================================================================

BEGIN
  EXECUTE 'SELECT count(*) FROM mytable WHERE inserted_by = $1 AND inserted <= $2'
    INTO c
    USING checked_user, checked_date;
  EXECUTE format('UPDATE tbl SET %I = $1 WHERE key = $2', colname) USING newvalue, keyvalue;
  EXECUTE 'DELETE FROM t' USING a INTO STRICT b;
  EXECUTE cmd;
END

================================================================================
RETURN
================================================================================

BEGIN
  RETURN;
  RETURN x + 1;
  RETURN (1, 2, 'three'::text);
  RETURN NEXT;
  RETURN NEXT r;
  RETURN QUERY SELECT * FROM foo WHERE fooid > 0;
  RETURN QUERY EXECUTE 'SELECT * FROM t WHERE a = $1' USING x;
END

================================================================================
RAISE
================================================================================

BEGIN
  RAISE;
  RAISE NOTICE 'Calling cs_create_job(%)', v_job_id;
  RAISE EXCEPTION 'Nonexistent ID --> %', user_id
    USING HINT = 'Please check your user ID';
  RAISE 'Duplicate user ID: %', user_id USING ERRCODE = 'unique_violation';
  RAISE division_by_zero;
  RAISE WARNING SQLSTATE '22012';
  RAISE USING MESSAGE = 'Something', DETAIL := 'x';
  RAISE DEBUG $$a "%" b$$, x;
  RAISE LOG E'a\'b';
  RAISE INFO 'x';
END
